title: Visual builder Accordion and Video modules

entries.summary: Catalog/normalize/render Accordion (details/summary) and Video (YouTube nocookie, Vimeo player, HTTPS file). parseVideoUrl builds iframe src; unknown hosts and javascript: URLs are dropped.
Accordion Content uses data-acc-idx/data-acc-field (not carousel slide attrs). Canvas lists titles and a video placeholder — no iframe. Video fields come from the catalog.
Default CSP frame-src adds youtube-nocookie.com and player.vimeo.com; media-src allows HTTPS video files. Custom HTML modules still strip iframes.
No schema change. Accordion items and Video URLs live in layout_json and restore with the SQL dump.
